violations.description: Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. To go cup lids were found on the floor of the storage are. Single use items should be stored off of the floor.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. Paper towels were not present at handwashing sink. Paper towels should be available at all times.
General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. Food employees did not wash their hands before preparing drinks. Hands should be washed before preparing food.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. Single use cups were found on the floor in the storage area. Single use items should be stored off of the floor.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. Single-use items were found stored on the floor of the back room. Single-use items should be stored off of the floor.
